findings.fix: Change spawn x to -100. Also consider adding a per-note 0.5s movement delay to match the Note.as base startingTime before stagger takes effect.

findings.what: fireCandleMissles inter-missile gap is 0.83s in TS but 0.5s+0.33s=0.83s in original — same total, but TS initial offset (1.3s) assumes lowercandle2 takes ~0.97s; if the animation is shorter the first missile fires late
findings.original: Boss_Cake.as:202-214: lowercandle2 anim plays; callback initFireCandles plays firecandle then schedules fireOneCandle at 0.33s. Missile 1 fires at (lowercandle2_duration + 0.33)s. Then 0.5s pause between candles (fireCandleFromTimer + 0.33s).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1427: after(1.3 + i*0.83, ...). Assumes lowercandle2 duration is ~0.97s so missile 1 fires at 1.3s. The first missile timing is hardcoded rather than driven by the animation callback, so it desynchronizes from the animation if lowercandle2's actual duration differs from 0.97s.
findings.fix: Inside the lowercandle2 completion callback (already present on line 1421), schedule the first candle at after(0.33, ...) relative to when lowercandle2 finishes, then chain subsequent missiles 0.83s apart from that callback.

findings.what: powerDown stun sound plays immediately in TS; original plays it as an animation-synced sound at 620ms into the get_stunned animation
findings.original: LevelBase.as:3550: AnimationSoundObject(620, ['durian_powerLoss'], false) registered on 'get_stunned' animation. Sound fires 620ms after the stun animation starts.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1464: audio.play('durian_powerLoss', 0, 0.7) called immediately when powerDown() is invoked, before the animation begins.
findings.fix: Remove the immediate audio.play call and instead register the sound as an animation callback at 620ms on the get_stunned animation, or use a this.after(0.62, ...) delay.

findings.what: recover animation plays into 'idle' in TS; original recover callback then calls getAction('flyup') which interrupts idle — TS has an extra idle frame gap before the flyup
findings.original: Boss_Cake.as:466-478: spriter.playAnim('recover', '', recoverComplete, true, true); recoverComplete plays 'idle' then immediately calls getAction('flyup'). The idle plays for exactly 0 frames before flyup is queued.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1471: spriter.playAnim('recover', 'idle', ...) chains directly to idle. actionTimer=2 was set 6s prior at the powerDown call. The timer fires 2s from then, i.e. well before recover completes. After recover finishes the boss is in idle briefly until actionTimer hits 0 and getAction is called.
findings.fix: Set actionTimer = 0 (or call getAction directly) inside the recover completion callback instead of setting it 6s before.

findings.what: Candle relight is per-candle in TS; original resets all candles' relight timer at every getAction call
findings.original: Boss_Cake.as:131-135: getAction() loops all candles and calls setRelightTime(4000 + 4000*healthRemainingPercent) on every action cycle. The relightTime reflects the current HP fraction and is updated every time any action fires.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1308: relight delay is computed once at the moment a candle goes out (4 + 4*hpFrac()) and never updated again. Later HP changes do not affect the pending relight timer for already-extinguished candles.
findings.fix: This is a minor behavioral deviation. If desired, compute hpFrac at the moment the relight timer fires (already done since hpFrac() is a live method) rather than at the moment candleOut() is called — the current code does call this.hpFrac() at candleOut time and that value is captured in the closure. The real gap is that the original updates ALL candles' timers on every action tick; TS only sets it once when the candle goes out. Low impact.

findings.what: defend_hit loops back to defend_idle in TS, but original returns to idle — boss stays in guard mode when it should drop it
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:301 — spriter.playAnim("defend_hit", "idle") — after being hit while guarding, next-loop anim is idle, dropping the guard
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1723 — spriter.playAnim('defend_hit', 'defend_idle', null, true) — loops back to defend_idle, Noodles stays in guarding pose indefinitely until the timed exit fires
findings.fix: Change the next-anim argument from 'defend_idle' to 'idle' on line 1723

findings.what: Superslash uses an instant point-test instead of a sweeping line — player can be standing at boss's start position but the boss flew past them and they still get hit (or vice versa)
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:217-230 — dispatches CHECK_SHOT_COLLISION with a line from (this.x, this.y-30) to (this.x±700, this.y-30) and damageDone=20; the level checks this against the player in the same frame, so the full slash trajectory is tested
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1659-1661 — single-frame point check at the moment startSuperSlash fires: if (Math.abs(player.y-40-(this.y-30)) < 55) hurtPlayer(20). Does not re-check during the xVel=100 travel across the stage
findings.fix: Track time elapsed in the superslash execution pass and check player.x is between start-x and current-x each frame while damageWindow is true, or emit a projectile object that travels with xVel=100 and damages on contact

findings.what: Combo attack xVel is decelerated by 0.85 each frame in TS but should stay constant throughout the combo animation
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:127-139 — action is set to EXECUTING_ACTION (not EXECUTING_SLASH); the update() loop at line 368 only applies xVel*=0.85 when currentAnim=='idle' OR action==EXECUTING_SLASH, so during EXECUTING_ACTION the xVel=2 set at line 135 persists flat across the whole slashCombo anim
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1643-1648 — mode is set to 'executing'; the switch default at line 1590-1592 and the idle/executing case both apply xVel*=0.85, so the xVel=2 decays to ~0 within ~4 frames instead of holding for the full combo duration
findings.fix: Give combo its own mode (e.g. 'combo') and skip the 0.85 decay for that mode, or hold xVel constant by reapplying it each frame during slashCombo

findings.what: onHurt defend exit uses a timed after() in TS instead of the original chooseNewAction scheduler — subtle but defend duration is self-contained and won't be preempted by the global action timer
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:270-276 — enters defend, then calls chooseNewActionSoon(random 0.5-2.0s); the DelayedCall fires chooseNewAttack which can be reset/cancelled by other events (e.g. backflip triggered before timer fires)
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1703-1709 — uses a local after() closure that directly sets invincible=false and actionTimer=0.01; this is not cancellable by other interrupt paths (e.g. getting hit a second time before defend ends)
findings.fix: Low-risk in practice; if re-hit while in defend the onHurt guard at line 1693 blocks (anim is defend_idle, not idle/run/hurt) so it won't stack. Acceptable simplification.

findings.what: Wall-dive: original jumpToWall anim plays with onWall as a completion callback; TS polls x<=45 or x>=755 each frame to detect wall contact — if boss overshoots or is at a partial wall x the onWall state may trigger at the wrong time
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:154-155 — spriter.playAnim('jumpToWall', '', onWall, true, true) — the onWall function fires when the anim finishes, not when the boss x reaches the wall; jumpToWall is presumably authored to end when the boss is at the wall
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1559-1571 — polls this.x <= 45 || this.x >= 755 every frame during wallArc; if the anim hasn't finished yet but the boss hits the boundary early, onWall fires prematurely (short arc). If xVel is too low and boss never reaches wall, it stays in wallArc forever
findings.fix: Use the anim completion callback instead of boundary polling: spriter.playAnim('jumpToWall', '', () => this.wallOnLand(), true, true) matching the original

findings.what: Wall pause before wall-push: original waits rand(50,1000)/1000 = 0.05-1.0s; TS rand(0.05,1.0) — this matches in range but the lower bound in original is 50ms exactly (integer division), and TS rand uses a float lower bound; functionally equivalent but the 0 lower bound edge case differs
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:174 — Helper.randomNumber(50, 1000)/1000 — integer range 50 to 1000 ms, so minimum 50ms pause on wall
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1566 — rand(0.05, 1.0) — correct equivalent range
findings.fix: No change needed — the values match

findings.what: wallPushFly xVel direction: after flip, TS reads this.faceOverride which was just multiplied by -1 (line 1681), so positive faceOverride -> xVel=18 (move right). Original: after scaleX*=-1, if new scaleX>0 xVel=-18 (move left). The signs are inverted — in TS faceOverride>0 means facing right, but original scaleX>0 after flip moves LEFT
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:183-198 — scaleX*=-1; then if(scaleX>0) xVel=-18 else xVel=18 — after flipping to face right (scaleX>0), boss flies LEFT at -18 (away from the wall it just pushed off of)
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1681-1685 — faceOverride*=-1; xVel = 18*(faceOverride) — after flip to faceOverride=1 (facing right), xVel=18 meaning boss flies RIGHT, same direction it faces. But a boss pushing off a left wall should face right and fly right — so TS is actually geometrically correct while original's sign looks inverted. Needs verification against animation.
findings.fix: Test in browser: if boss pushes off left wall (at x~150) it should fly right toward center. If TS already does this correctly no change needed. The original sign may be a quirk of scaleX vs direction conventions.

findings.what: After backflip, original fires chooseNewActionSoon(1) from addBackflipVel (0.375s into backflip), then backflipFinished calls startSlash directly — the chooseNew timer fires 1s after the velocity kick, potentially while slash is already executing
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:488-498 + 305-309 — addBackflipVel sets chooseNewActionSoon(1) at t=0.375s into backflip; backflipFinished (at anim end) directly calls startSlash(); so slash always happens, and the chooseNew 1s timer can fire mid-slash and pick a new action
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1731-1744 — backflip anim callback calls startSlash(); no competing chooseNew timer; a separate after(1.0) safety fallback sets mode=idle only if still in backflip — this is cleaner and avoids the original's potential mid-slash interruption
findings.fix: TS behavior is arguably more correct; keep as-is

findings.what: Slash action next-timer set at entry not at execution: original's startSlash (line 123) sets the next-action timer to rand(1.4,2.4)s at the moment slash begins; TS line 1640 does the same. But TS also resets actionTimer to rand(1.4,2.4) inside startSlash while the approach loop was running — if approach took 3s the timer was already ticking. In TS the timer is only reset upon entering startSlash, matching original.
findings.original: Boss_Noodles.as:123 — chooseNewActionSoon(rand(1400,2400)/1000) inside startSlash
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:1640 — this.actionTimer = rand(1.4, 2.4) inside startSlash — matches
findings.fix: No change needed

findings.what: blast action: 3 up-wasabi mortars fire on fixed timers instead of sequentially after each animation completes
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as lines 225-243: blastOne() plays 'blast' anim with uninterruptable flag, fires projectile at 0.185s via delayCall, then waits for the full animation callback (blastFinished) before calling blastOne() again. The three upward wasabi shots are strictly sequential — shot 2 only fires after shot 1's full animation finishes. After all 3, boss plays 'idle_noHat', then starts the falling wasabi phase (lines 246-266).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts lines 1894-1908: all 3 upward blasts are pre-scheduled with fixed offsets (0.2s, 0.7s, 1.2s). Each iteration replays 'blast' anim from scratch on a timer, completely overlapping if the anim is longer than 0.5s. The fallback to idle_noHat between up-phase and falling-phase is absent. Falling wasabi starts unconditionally at 1.8s regardless of whether all 3 anims actually finished.
findings.fix: Port the callback-chain: play 'blast' uninterruptable, fire projectile at 0.185s, on anim-complete increment a counter and call blastOne again (or move to falling phase). After all 3 up-shots play idle_noHat before scheduling falling wasabi. Total duration before next action should be ~3× blast-anim-length + 3×0.425s + 0.5s, not a fixed 3.6s.

findings.what: orbiting shields start orbiting immediately on spawn instead of after a 1-second scale-in tween completes
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as lines 127-138: callSushi spawns 3 sushi, sets their scaleX/Y=0, tweens them to scale 0.4 over 1s with 1s delay (total 2s), and only in the tween's onComplete sets sushiActive = true. The update() method checks sushiActive before calling updateSushiPos() (lines 604-606), so shields don't orbit until the tween finishes. Initial angles are [0, PI/1.33, PI*1.33] = [0, ~2.36, ~4.19].
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts lines 1815-1829: orbs are spawned via spawnChild at the center position (x, y-75) with canUpdate=false and canDamage=false. updateOrbs() is called every frame from runAI (line 1778) and immediately begins moving all living orbs — there is no scale-in tween and no activation delay. Orbs start orbiting and can contact the player from the first frame.
findings.fix: Spawn orbs at scale 0 (or hidden), add a ~2s delay before enabling their orbit movement. A simple flag (orbsActive) initialized false, set to true after 2s via this.after(2, ...) in the callSushi case, then checked in updateOrbs, matches the original feel.

findings.what: rapid-cut initial velocity direction: boss always moves toward player regardless of position (original has a bug that should be reproduced for feel consistency)
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as lines 519-526: startRapid() has two branches (bunny.x > this.x vs else). BOTH branches set scaleX = SCALE (positive). When bunny is to the right: scaleX=+SCALE, xVel=+4 (moves right toward bunny). When bunny is to the left: scaleX=+SCALE (faces right, AWAY from bunny), xVel=-4 (moves left toward bunny). So the boss always lunges toward the player at xVel=4 but may face the wrong way when player is left. This is an original bug but is what was shipped.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts lines 1783-1787: rapidFlip fires every 0.25s flipping faceOverride and xVel. On the very first frame of rapid (rapidFlip initialised to 0), the first flip fires immediately (0.25s later), not at start. The initial xVel is set to 0 and not set to 4 until the first flip fires. So the boss stands still for 0.25s before moving, instead of immediately lunging.
findings.fix: On entering rapid state, set xVel = 4 * (sign toward player) and rapidFlip = 0.25 so the first direction-change happens after 0.25s rather than immediately. Replicate original's always-positive scaleX at rapid start if desired for fidelity.

findings.what: forward_blast: soy-sauce fires TOWARD player but original fires AWAY from boss facing (which ends up toward player) — direction is correct but facing pre-blast is set differently, causing visual mismatch
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as lines 154-158: before playing pre_forward_blast, boss explicitly sets scaleX based on bunny position — if bunny.x < this.x, scaleX = +SCALE (face right, i.e., AWAY from bunny who is left). Then addSoySauceProjectile (lines 443-468): if scaleX < 0, xVel = +12; else xVel = -12. Net result: boss turns away from player, then blasts backward — it's a 'surprise' shot to their back.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts lines 1808-1809: getAction() sets faceOverride toward the player before every action. Line 1886: fires at 12 * faceOverride, which fires TOWARD the player (faceOverride = -1 when player is left, xVel = -12). The boss faces the player and blasts them directly — the original's 'turn-away-then-blast' mechanic is lost.
findings.fix: In the forward_blast case, before playing pre_forward_blast, explicitly flip faceOverride to AWAY from player (faceOverride = player.x < this.x ? 1 : -1), and fire with xVel = -12 * faceOverride (same as original's scaleX-based logic). This preserves the 'turn your back and blast' feel.

findings.what: sendSushi: launched sushi velocity uses boss faceOverride (toward player) but original always fires in the boss's current facing direction with a fixed xVel=3
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as lines 188-213: send1Sushi fires each visible orb as a new Spriter projectile at xVel=3 (positive), then checks scaleX < 0 to negate it (lines 202-203). Direction is based on boss's current scaleX at send time. yVel is always +1 (slight downward arc). Stagger is 0.25s between each of 3 orbs, first at 0.8s delay from sendSushi anim start.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts lines 1913-1929: uses 3 * (faceOverride ?? 1) for xVel and +1 for yVel. Since faceOverride is set toward the player at the start of every getAction call (line 1809), orbs always fire toward the player. This is likely correct in practice but the timing is slightly wrong: the original fires the last orb at 0.8 + 0.5 = 1.3s; ours fires up to sent*0.25 + 0.8 (non-existent orbs are skipped). If all 3 orbs exist the timings match.
findings.fix: Minor: if any orbs were destroyed before sendSushi, ours skips them cleanly. The direction math is functionally equivalent given faceOverride. No change strictly needed, but verify orbs destroyed mid-orbit are skipped rather than crashing.

findings.what: throwFish: facing is set TOWARD player before throw, but original sets it based on player position at throw time using explicit scaleX logic (same result but with boundary condition for equal x)
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as lines 347-354: throwFish() checks bunny.x < this.x → scaleX = -SCALE (face left, toward left-player); bunny.x > this.x → scaleX = +SCALE (face right, toward right-player). No else — if exactly equal, scaleX unchanged. Fish velocity uses atan2 aimed at bunny.y-30 with normalize(8) (speed 8 pixels/frame = 480 px/s at 60fps).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts line 1851: normalizes (dx, dy) by Math.hypot and multiplies by 8. This correctly yields speed 8. faceOverride is set toward player at action start. Functionally equivalent for fish direction and speed.
findings.fix: No change needed for fish velocity/direction. The equal-x edge case (no else) is negligible.

findings.what: throwFish boomerang return: original chains catchFish→idle after boomerangReturned callback; ours hard-codes a 2.2s timer without a true boomerang return callback
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as lines 417-424: boomerangReturned() is called by the projectile system when the boomerang returns to boss. It plays 'catchFish' then 'idle', and schedules the next action with delay 2. This is event-driven — if the fish is destroyed early or returns fast the timing adjusts.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts lines 1854-1859: uses a hard-coded this.after(2.2, ...) to simulate the catch. If the projectile is still in flight at 2.2s (possible given disappearTime=1.7s in XML — the fish should be gone by then), or if the boomerang system fires a real callback, both paths could trigger. The 2.2s approximation means noFish stays true for a fixed window rather than until actual return.
findings.fix: Check whether the projectile service fires a boomerang-return event/callback to the boss. If so, wire boomerangReturned() to play catchFish and set actionTimer=2 as original does. The 2.2s hard-code is close but event-driven is more robust.

findings.what: callSushi does not set sushiActive flag / orbit angles differ from original initialization
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as line 124: initial orbit angles are [0, PI/1.33, PI*1.33] ≈ [0, 2.36, 4.19 rad]. Orbits only begin after tween onComplete sets sushiActive=true.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts line 1818: orbAngles = [0, Math.PI/1.33, Math.PI*1.33] — identical values. No sushiActive guard (see finding 2). Values match.
findings.fix: Angle initialization is correct. The only issue is the missing activation delay (covered in finding 2).

findings.what: orbit shield contact hitbox is tighter than original's bounding-rect intersection
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as line 578: uses getBounds() to get the actual sprite bounding rectangle, then checks if it intersects LevelBase.bunnyRectangle. Sushi rolls are drawn at scale 0.4 so the hitbox matches their visual size.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts line 1944: uses a fixed box check: abs(orb.x - player.x) < 40 && abs(orb.y - (player.y-40)) < 45. This is a manually specified 80×90 px box centered on the orb, which may not match the actual sprite bounds of a sushi roll at scale 0.4.
findings.fix: Low priority — confirm the sushi roll sprite dimensions. If the sushi roll at scale 0.4 is roughly 80-90px wide/tall, the box is fine. Otherwise adjust to match the actual rendered size, or use a bounding-box API if available.

findings.what: onHurt counter: 1-in-7 probability uses floor(rand(0,7))===0 which is equivalent to original's randomNumber(0,6)===0, but rand() upper-bound semantics must be confirmed
findings.original: Boss_Sushi.as line 494: Helper.randomNumber(0, 6) returns an integer in [0, 6] inclusive (7 values), triggers rapid when result == 0 → 1/7 probability.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts line 1962: Math.floor(rand(0, 7)) === 0. If rand(0,7) is [0,7) exclusive, this gives 1/7 probability — correct. If rand's upper bound is inclusive this gives 1/8.
findings.fix: Verify the rand() utility's upper-bound exclusivity. If rand(min, max) returns [min, max) then Math.floor(rand(0,7)) gives [0..6] — correct 1/7.

findings.what: Fly slam uses immediate position snap instead of EASE_IN_OUT tween; slam starts falling with yVel=6 instead of yVel=1
findings.original: Boss_Hamburger.as:191-218 — addJumpVel sets yVel=-10, then after 1s prepareForSlam fires a Tween(this, 1, EASE_IN_OUT) to randomNumber(100,700) x and y=40 (with 0.25s tween delay), onComplete=addSlamVel which sets yVel=1 (gentle gravity take-over). The EASE_IN_OUT repositioning tween takes 1s + 0.25s delay to position the boss. Total air time before slam: ~2.25s minimum (1s delay + 0.25 tween delay + 1s tween) after the initial yVel=-10 launch.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2070-2084 — when y < -150 (not time-based), immediately snaps x = 100+Math.random()*600, y = -60, then after(0.5, ...) drops with yVel=6. No tween, no EASE_IN_OUT. The repositioning is instant and the slam fall speed (6) is 6x the original (1).
findings.fix: Replace the flyPhase=1/2 instant snap with a delayed call after 1s, then tween(boss, 1, easeInOut) to the random x and y=40 with 0.25s tween delay. After tween completes, set yVel=1 (not 6) and set flyPhase=3. The original slam is gravity-pulled, not velocity-launched.

findings.what: Suck mechanic is a simple xVel nudge instead of a full pull+disable+KO-anim+chew trigger system; bunny keeps control during suck
findings.original: LevelBase.as:3741-3770 — moveBunnyToGravityPosition fires every ENTER_FRAME: if bunny.x is >30px from gravityPosition.x, adds bunny.acceleration*0.9 to xVel AND nudges x by ±1 each frame. When within 30px, immediately zeros xVel/yVel, canUpdate=false, tweens bunny to gravityPosition over 0.3s, calls disableBunnyControls(), plays ko/ko_idle anim, then calls gravityEnemy.onBunnyReached(). Bunny loses all control. onBunnyReached (Boss_Hamburger.as:252-264) then guards on heartChildEnemy.shouldBeInvincible before firing chew. Gravity point is (this.x, this.y-40) so it pulls toward mouth center.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2040-2066, Game.ts:464-467 — pullPlayer adds Math.sign(dx)*0.55 to player.xVel once per tick, ignored if player.hasIFrames. No y-axis pull. Player retains full movement control. Catch box is 55x80px bounding check (line 2043). No ko anim, no control disable, no canUpdate=false.
findings.fix: pullPlayer needs to also pull yVel toward the mouth, disable player input when sufficiently close, zero velocities, tween player to mouth pos, set canUpdate=false, play ko/ko_idle anim, then trigger the chew. The pull strength should scale with bunny.acceleration (0.9x) not a fixed constant. Guard onBunnyReached when heart is not currently exposed.

findings.what: Spit does not launch bunny with ko_fly anim + directional velocity; player just takes a damage hit instead
findings.original: Boss_Hamburger.as:271-288 — after chew anim completes, spit() starts spit anim then 0.8s later addSpitVel fires SPIT_OUT_BUNNY with Point(±10, -7). LevelBase.as:3712-3732 — spitOutBunny: sets bunny.canUpdate=true, plays ko_fly anim, sets bunny.xVel=±10 and yVel=-7, facing-corrected. After landing, bunny stands up with groundToIdle. This is a full projectile launch of the bunny.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2047-2057 — after chew completes, plays spit anim then after(0.8) calls hurtPlayer(attackDmg=25, faceOverride) and shake(3). No velocity override, no ko_fly, player stays in place.
findings.fix: After spit anim + 0.8s delay, instead of hurtPlayer, call a spitPlayer service that sets player xVel = ±10 (based on burger facing), yVel = -7, re-enables player update, plays ko_fly anim (or equivalent knock-back state).

findings.what: onHurt does not force a fly-slam escape; burger stays in place after the heart is hit
findings.original: Boss_Hamburger.as:376-402 — onHurt sets action=HURT, calls super.onHurt() (plays hurt anim), calls heartInvincible(), then jumpAwaySoon() which after 0.25s calls chooseNewAttack("fly"). This forces an immediate fly-slam every time the heart is damaged. The player gets a brief counterplay window but the boss immediately escapes by flying up.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2186-2191 — onHurt plays 'hurt' then 'idle'. No forced fly. After hurt the boss just resumes normal action loop. The escape mechanic is completely absent.
findings.fix: In onHurt, after the hurt anim completes, call getAction with 'fly' forced (bypass actionIndex), similar to how the original calls chooseNewAttack('fly') after 0.25s.

findings.what: Chew initial bite damage fires immediately instead of at 0.2s, and uses half of attackDmg (12) instead of the full injureBunny(30) value
findings.original: Boss_Hamburger.as:262-268 — nextActionDC2.reset(injureBunny, 0.2) fires INJURE_BUNNY_FROM_HAMBURGER at 0.2s into the chew anim. LevelBase.as:3872-3877 — injureBunnyFromHamburger calls injureBunny(30). A flat 30 damage, not derived from attackDmg (which is 25 per XML).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2059 — hurtPlayer(Math.ceil(attackDmg/2), 0) fires synchronously when chewing begins (no delay). Damage is Math.ceil(25/2) = 13, and direction is 0 (no knockback direction). Then a second hurtPlayer(attackDmg=25) fires at 0.8s on spit.
findings.fix: Change initial chew damage to after(0.2, ...) with flat value 30 (hardcoded, matching original). Remove the second hurtPlayer at spit time — spit should trigger the velocity launch, not another damage event.

findings.what: shoot360 action duration is 3.8s instead of ~2.2s (0.2s pre-delay + 2s action timer)
findings.original: Boss_Hamburger.as:295-307 — startShoot360 fires at 0.2s (nextActionDC.reset(startShoot360, 0.2)), then inside startShoot360 calls chooseNewActionSoon(2). So the effective action window is ~2.2s total from action start.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2121 — actionTimer = 3.8 set immediately at action start, i.e. 3.8s before next action. This is 1.6s longer than the original.
findings.fix: Set actionTimer = 2.2 (or schedule the next action at 2s from the start of seed spray, matching chooseNewActionSoon(2) from inside startShoot360).

findings.what: shoot (shootAtBunny) action duration is 1.9s instead of 1.5s
findings.original: Boss_Hamburger.as:309-321 — startShootAtBunny calls chooseNewActionSoon(1.5). Action starts 0.1s into the shoot action, so total window is ~1.6s from action start.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2134 — actionTimer = 1.9. That is 0.3-0.4s longer.
findings.fix: Set actionTimer = 1.6 (matching 0.1s pre-delay + 1.5s chooseNewActionSoon).

findings.what: Heart attach offset places heart at y-60 above boss origin instead of the original y-50 (updateYOffset) with spriter y-offset of -30
findings.original: LevelBase.as:4335 — heart.setParentEnemy(enemy, 0, -30, -50): spriter is drawn at (0, -30) relative to heart's position, and heart.y = burger.y + updateYOffset(-50). So heart's world y = burger.y - 50, but heart's spriter is another -30 lower making visual center at burger.y - 80.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2025 — heart.attachTo(this, 0, -60). Heart's position tracks burger at offset (0, -60). Different Y, the heart visual sits ~20px higher than in the original.
findings.fix: Match original: heart tracks boss.y - 50 (updateYOffset), and the heart's spriter/visual should be offset an additional -30 within the heart container to put the visual at burger.y - 80.

findings.what: Heart HP is set to 9999 in XML (spawned with that value) but the code never explicitly resets it after re-use; the original resets it to 99999 on each spawn
findings.original: LevelBase.as:4333 — heart.hpRemaining = 99999 explicitly set every time a heart is attached to the boss before startAI(). The XML hp=9999 is just a default; the real value for the fight is 99999 (effectively invincible unless player hits it during exposed window).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2024-2031 — the AttachedMinion is spawned fresh via spawnChild('hamburger_heart', ...) with the XML hp=9999. No override to 99999. In practice the heart can be killed in 7 hits (at typical player damage) when it should require ~20+ hits for the same damage.
findings.fix: After spawning the heart, explicitly set heart.hp = 99999 (or a suitably large value) before attaching, matching the original.

findings.what: Spawn seed burst uses sprayAngle accumulated state (shared with shoot360) and fires 15 seeds with angle increment 0.42; original uses activePoints[0].angle from the Spriter rig for each seed
findings.original: Boss_Hamburger.as:329-372 — fireOneSeed reads spriter.activePoints[0].angle for the direction of each seed, oriented along the rig's point timeline. Seeds travel along the authored angle, mirrored by scaleX. During spawn, 15 seeds fired at 0.05s intervals.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2019-2020 — fires 15 seeds accumulating sprayAngle += 0.42 per seed, starting from the current shared sprayAngle value. This is a mathematical approximation since activePoints are not read. Visually similar but angle increments don't follow the rig animation.
findings.fix: Low priority since the rig point may not be parsed, but ideally read the seed point from the Spriter rig for each frame. As a compromise, reset sprayAngle=0 at the start of each spawn/shoot360 to avoid compounding drift between actions.

findings.what: shoot360 fires 30 seeds with angle increment 0.21 (total sweep ~6.3 rad ≈ 1 full turn) but the angular step is slightly off from a clean 360/30 distribution
findings.original: Boss_Hamburger.as:295-306 — 30 seeds, each using activePoints[0].angle from the rig (the rig animates the point to sweep around). The spread is driven by the authored animation, not a fixed angular step.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2119 — 30 seeds, sprayAngle += 0.21 per seed. 30 * 0.21 = 6.3 rad ≈ 1.0 full revolution. This is a reasonable approximation but starts from an arbitrary accumulated angle rather than resetting.
findings.fix: Reset sprayAngle = 0 at the start of each shoot360 action to ensure a consistent sweep every time.

findings.what: KO break HP thresholds are wrong — first break fires too early and subsequent breaks are at different HP values
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:50,64 — `nextHpLevel = maxHP - 1000` (first break at HP=7000 with maxHP=8000 from XML). Each subsequent break decrements by 2000 (line 325: `nextHpLevel -= 2000`), so breaks occur at 7000, 5000, 3000 HP.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2230 — `this.nextHpLevel = this.type.hp - Math.floor(this.type.hp / 4)` = 8000 - 2000 = 6000 for first break. Line 2356: `this.nextHpLevel -= Math.floor(this.type.hp / 4)` decrements by 2000 each time. Breaks at 6000, 4000, 2000 HP — 1000 HP too early each time.
findings.fix: Change spawnAt line 2230 to `this.nextHpLevel = this.type.hp - 1000` (fixed 1000, not a quarter). The per-break decrement of 2000 (line 2356) is already correct.

findings.what: Break-apart spawns only 4 generic pieces instead of the original 14 pre-built enemies with body-part positions
findings.original: LevelBase.as:4347-4420 — on initial boss spawn, 14 enemies are pre-created in `monsterArray`: 4 MiddleSlammer (pizza, id=2), 4 hotdog (id=0), 4 nugget (id=4), 1 coke (id=1), 1 fry (id=5). On break (LevelBase.as:4619-4668), each is placed at a precise offset from the boss body (e.g. pizza at (-112*SCALE, -368*SCALE) relative to boss) then scatter with xVel in [-3,3], yVel in [-5,-1]. All can damage the player during KO phase.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2376-2389 — spawns only 4 enemies (alternating hotdog/nugget) at `rand(-80,80)` x-offset and `y-40-i*30` y-offset from boss center. No MiddleSlammer, no coke, no fry. 14 body-part positions lost entirely.
findings.fix: Pre-create 14 enemies matching the original types. On breakApart, place them at the exact body-part offsets (pizza: [-112,-368], [138,-334], [-68,-120], [60,-106]; hotdog: [-33,-307], [46,-302], [-17,-220], [30,-208]; nugget: [-142,-383], [168,-347], [-80,-80], [75,-75]; coke: [10,-210]; fry: [5,-360] — all scaled by SCALE=0.55). Track all 14 in koRemaining.

findings.what: Reform requires only 4 KO'd pieces; original requires all 14
findings.original: LevelBase.as:4678 — `if(comboBoss.numKO >= 14)` triggers the reform sequence. All 14 pre-built pieces must be individually KO'd.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2374,2385 — `this.koRemaining` starts at the number of spawned pieces (4). Calls `reform()` when `koRemaining <= 0`, so only 4 KOs needed.
findings.fix: Once pieces are corrected to 14, this fixes itself — koRemaining will start at 14.

findings.what: Roar action spawns wrong enemy types and delays the summon 6x too long
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:189 — `summonMoreEnemies` is called at `0.05s` delay. LevelBase.as:4612 — `spawnMoreComboEnemies` spawns 6 enemies: id=0 (hotdog) x2, id=1 (coke) x2, id=3 (donut) x1, id=5 (fry) x1, each staggered 0.2s, from random x=[100,700] at y=-20 (falling from above), NOT as KO enemies (they fight normally).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2334-2338 — after `0.3s` delay, spawns only 1 hotdog + 1 nugget from the screen edges (x=-30 or x=830). Uses `spawnChild` which routes through normal enemy spawn.
findings.fix: Change delay to 0.05s. Spawn 6 enemies matching the original ids (2 hotdog, 2 coke, 1 donut, 1 fry) from random x positions at y=-20, staggered 0.2s apart, as normal (non-KO) enemies. Remove the edge-spawn approach.

findings.what: Stomp end-of-wall next-action delay is 5x too long
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:415,423 — after hitting the wall boundary during stomp, calls `chooseNewActionSoon(0.1)` — only 0.1s before the next action.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2266 — sets `this.actionTimer = 0.5` — 0.5s delay, 5x longer than original.
findings.fix: Change actionTimer in the stomp wall-hit block (line 2266) to 0.1.

findings.what: Stomp turnaround flips facing with scaleX; our TS uses faceOverride set to the opposite direction but the flip semantics differ
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:417,425 — `this.scaleX *= -1` — multiplies by -1, reversing whatever direction was set, so the boss ends the stomp facing back the way it came.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2264 — `this.faceOverride = dir * -1` — sets to the opposite of stomp direction. Functionally equivalent intent, but faceOverride only controls the sprite; if the underlying xVel drift continues before the idle friction applies the boss may face the wrong way for one frame.
findings.fix: Minor; can keep as-is or clamp xVel to 0 immediately on wall contact (which we do: line 2262), so this is low-risk. Verify in browser that the boss faces inward after each stomp.

findings.what: handNuggetBlast nugget projectile scale is 0.45 vs original 0.3 (50% larger visually)
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:269,271 — scale is `0.3` when facing right, `-0.3` when facing left (negative scale flips the sprite horizontally to match direction).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2324 — `scale: 0.45` passed to services.shoot, always positive (no direction flip via negative scale).
findings.fix: Change scale to 0.3. Also pass a negative scale value when `this.faceOverride === -1` to flip the sprite, matching the original's directional flip.

findings.what: handNuggetBlast nugget uses a hardcoded fallback spawn position instead of the rig's active point
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:276-297 — uses `spriter.activePoints[0].x/y` (a SCON point timeline named marker on the hand) scaled by SCALE=0.55. When facing left: `x = this.x - (point.x * SCALE)`, `y = this.y + (point.y * SCALE)`. When facing right: `x = this.x + (point.x * SCALE)`, same y formula.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2318-2320 — calls `this.pointPos(0)` and falls back to `this.x + 60 * (this.faceOverride ?? 1)` / `this.y - 120`. The fallback values (60px, 120px) are approximate and may be inaccurate; the original x-offset direction sign is also inverted when facing left.
findings.fix: Ensure the boss_combo SCON has a point timeline on the hand. If pointPos(0) works, verify it applies the correct facing sign (subtract x when facing left, add when facing right). If no point timeline exists in the scon, use measured bone-chain output from getPart on the hand joint.

findings.what: handNuggetBlast does not track player facing during the animation; original continuously re-faces during BLASTING state
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:443-448 — in per-frame update(), while `action == BLASTING`, boss continuously updates scaleX to face the player: `if(bunny.x < this.x && scaleX > 0) scaleX = -SCALE; else if(bunny.x > this.x && scaleX < 0) scaleX = SCALE`.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2273-2275 — faceOverride is only updated when in 'idle' state or playing handNuggetBlast by checking `currentAnimationName`. There is no per-frame tracking during the blast state; once the anim starts the face direction is locked.
findings.fix: In runAI, add a check: if currently in handNuggetBlast state (track with a boolean or check animName), update faceOverride to track player each frame, matching original line 443-448.

findings.what: handNuggetBlast next-action timer is 1.5s; original uses 1.0s after firing
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:309 — inside `fireNugget()`, calls `chooseNewActionSoon(1)` — 1.0s after firing before next action.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2326 — `this.actionTimer = 1.5` set at action-start (not after fire callback), so the total time is longer. The actionTimer is set to 1.5s when the action begins; the fire fires at 0.515s in, meaning next action is ~1.5s from start vs original ~1.515s from start. Close but the timer is set before the delayed fire, not after it.
findings.fix: Set actionTimer inside the after(0.515) callback to `this.actionTimer = 1.0`, to match the 1s post-fire wait of the original.

findings.what: fry projectile y-position uses hardcoded 184 instead of the data-derived 335*SCALE
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:249 — `projectileData.y = this.y - (335 * SCALE)` = `this.y - 184.25`.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2300 — `this.y - 184`. Value is essentially the same (184 vs 184.25) — negligible difference.
findings.fix: No functional change needed; consider using `335 * ENEMY_SCALE` for documentation clarity.

findings.what: Roar camera shake magnitude differs: original shakes at 3, ours at 5
findings.original: Boss_Combo.as:192 — `dispatchEventWith('CAMERA_SHAKE', true, [680, 3])` — shake magnitude 3.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2333 — `this.services?.shake(5)` — magnitude 5.
findings.fix: Change shake(5) for the roar action to shake(3).

findings.what: Reform animation plays 'spawn' then 'idle'; original's reform uses unKO anims on pieces then hides them and calls spawn() on the boss directly
findings.original: LevelBase.as:4686-4718 — on last KO, pieces tween to positions playing 'unKO'→'unKOIdle' anim over 1.5s, then after 3s all pieces hide and `comboBoss.spawn()` is called (which plays 'spawn'→activate→'idle'). Total reform time: ~4.5s after last KO.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2401-2410 — immediately clears pieces, plays 'spawn'→'idle', sets actionTimer=2. Total reform time: ~2s (spawn anim duration + 2s timer).
findings.fix: Add an unKO reassembly phase: before clearing pieces, play 'unKO'→'unKOIdle' on each piece while tweening them toward the boss center position over 1.5s, then after a 3s total wait call the actual boss spawn sequence. Requires tweening support or a multi-step after() chain.

findings.what: Sundae form: stun mechanic is completely wrong — original requires slashing projectiles back into Burrito, ours counts blocked melee hits
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:53 hitsToStun=1, :1394-1401 sundae_update checks each SundaeProjectile in activeProjectileArray for .slashed==true, then if it intersects Burrito's bounds it increments currentHitCount and calls sundae_powerDown(). One slash-back stuns. The projectile sits on the scoop rig point before being thrown, and the player must hit it in flight to reflect it.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2586-2594 onBlockedHit() increments blockedHits and stuns after 5 blocked hits. su_throw (line 2802) fires a normal aimedShot projectile — no scoop-hold mechanic, no slash-back, player just tanks melee attacks until guard breaks.
findings.fix: Replace the blocked-hit counter with a reflect mechanic: su_throw should place a SundaeProjectile on the scoop (attachable display object or tracked sprite), and a slash collision on that projectile while in flight should trigger guardBroken. hitsToStun=1 so the first reflect stuns.

findings.what: Hamburger form: ham_suck and ham_fly actions are entirely absent — the suck/heart-expose core mechanic never runs in BurritoBoss
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:98 allActionsArray[8] = [ham_shoot360, ham_shoot, ham_suck, ham_fly, ham_fly]. :2340-2395 ham_suck plays ham_start_suck, then ham_suck_idle, calls ham_heartExposed() (makes heart hittable), starts a pull-player gravity toward Burrito for 4.5s. If player reaches Burrito it triggers chew+spit (ham_chew, ham_spit). ham_fly (:2346-2382) plays ham_flyUp, adds yVel=-15 at 0.295s, then at 2s teleports to random x 100-700 and slam-drops.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2446 hamburger phase actions=['hm_shoot360','hm_shoot'] — only 2 actions. The heart minion is spawned (nextPhase line 2497 note absent, checked spawnAt) but it is always invincible because ham_heartExposed() is never called and ham_suck never runs, so the player cannot attack the heart at all.
findings.fix: Add hm_suck action: expose heart (set invincible=false on heart child), trigger services.pullPlayer toward this.x for 4.5s, end with heart going invincible again. Add hm_fly action: playAnim ham_flyUp, yVel=-15 at 0.295s, teleport after 2s to random x, slam down. Update hamburger phase actions to ['hm_shoot360','hm_shoot','hm_suck','hm_fly','hm_fly'].

findings.what: Pumpkin form: pumpkin_sideblast action is missing — the off-screen side-blast attack (a visually distinctive move) never fires
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:93 allActionsArray[3] = [pumpkin_flyingslash, pumpkin_slash, idle, pumpkin_slash, pumpkin_sideblast]. :1004-1096 pumpkin_sideblast: Burrito flies off-screen, appears at random y 100-320, tweens to edge x (50 or 750), fires pumpkin_sideblast anim 3 times (dispatching SUPER_BLAST each time which is the PumpkinBlast image sweeping across), then tweens back off-screen and calls chooseNewActionSoon(1).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2441 pumpkin phase actions=['pk_flyslash','pk_slash','rest','pk_slash'] — pumpkin_sideblast absent entirely.

findings.what: Durian form: dur_slam is an invented behavior — original has dur_flyCrush which visits three fixed x positions (100, 400, 700) sequentially with a slam each time
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:583-585 dur_flyCrush calls dur_doSlam() which sets flyUpForSlam=true. :692-810 durian_update FLYING mode: floats up to y<40, then moves to slamXArray[shoot1Index]±30 (values 100,400,700), plays dur_slam at that position, then falls to DURIAN_GROUNDY=320. Repeats incrementing shoot1Index; after 3 slams shoot1Index resets and chooseNewActionSoon(2). Action loop has dur_flyCrush three times in a row (indices 3,4,5).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2748-2759 dur_slam: immediately teleports x to 0 or 800, sets yVel=-5, and enters 'spin' mode which drops back to ground via gravity. No multi-position sequence; only one landing; no fly-up-to-and-hover-then-slam pattern.
findings.fix: Implement dur_flyCrush: fly up until y<40, then sequentially glide to x=100, 400, 700 and play dur_slam each time (canDamage=true on slam), after 3 slams return to idle. The three consecutive dur_flyCrush entries in the action array produce 9 total slams per cycle.

findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:92 allActionsArray[2] = [egg_onetwo, egg_onetwo, egg_turnpunch, egg_rapidpunch, idle]. :834-838 egg_rapidpunch plays egg_pre_onetwo into egg_rapidpunch loop, moves at xVel=0.5 in facing dir, calls egg_turnAround every 3s (random chance to stop). A 5-action loop.

findings.what: Hamburger shoot360: actionTimer is 3.2s but original waits 5s total before next action
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:2461 chooseNewActionSoon(5) after initiating 15 shots at 0.1s intervals. The animation itself plays and the next action delay is 5 seconds from the start of the shoot.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2961 actionTimer=3.2. 15 shots span 0.2 to 1.6s; the boss picks its next action at 3.2s, 1.8s early.
findings.fix: Change actionTimer for hm_shoot360 from 3.2 to 5.0.

findings.what: Watermelon shoot: fires only one variant per call; original picks shoot1 or shoot2 but uses a single sequential-fire loop, ours randomly picks anim but fires all 5 shots as immediate after() calls instead of a sequential chain that validates animation state each step
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:430-444 water_shoot1/2: fires first at 0.07+0.22=0.29s, each subsequent at +0.22s; each call to water_shootOne checks currentAnimationName to bail early if interrupted. If 5 shots fire, chooseNewActionSoon(0.5).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2731-2734 schedules all 5 at 0.1+i*0.22s simultaneously via after(); actionTimer=1.8s (next action at 1.8s vs original 1.27s shooting + 0.5s = 1.77s, roughly similar). No animation-state guard on individual shots.
findings.fix: Low priority in practice since timing is close. If shots fire during an interrupted animation the projectiles still appear. Consider adding alive check (already done) and matching the 0.07s initial delay rather than 0.1s. Original uses 0.07+0.22 = first shot at 0.29s; ours fires first at 0.1s — 0.19s earlier.

findings.what: Sushi sh_blast: fires all 3 upward blasts simultaneously from fixed timers; original plays full sushi_blast animation sequentially for each of 3 shots before firing falling wasabi
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:2058-2110 sushi_start3Blasts: calls sushi_blastOne, which plays sushi_blast anim and fires at 0.185s into it; on anim complete increments counter, if <3 calls sushi_blastOne again. After 3 anims calls sushi_startFallingWasabi which fires 3 falling wasabi at 0.425s intervals. Each upward blast is a separate full animation play.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2932-2944 schedules 3 blasts at 0.2+i*0.45s gaps overlapping (each plays 'sushi_blast' on top of the last), then schedules 3 falling at 1.8+i*0.425s. The animation flicker from 3 rapid playAnim calls will look wrong.
findings.fix: Play the full sushi_blast anim once per shot sequentially: chain via anim callback. After all 3 blasts return to idle_sushi then fire the 3 falling wasabi with 0.425s spacing.

findings.what: Pumpkin form: scale does not shrink as HP drops within the form
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:2554-2567 onHurt case 3: specialScale = (SCALE+0.2) - (0.6 * dmgPercent) where dmgPercent is damage taken as fraction of this form's HP pool. Pumpkin starts at scale 0.75 (SCALE=0.55+0.20) and shrinks toward 0.15 as HP depletes. scaleX and scaleY are updated each hit.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2596-2604 onHurt has no scale adjustment. Pumpkin form stays at constant scale throughout the form.
findings.fix: In onHurt when form.key==='pumpkin', compute dmgPercent = (totalFormHp - hpRemainingInForm) / totalFormHp and set spriter.scale = (0.75) - (0.6 * dmgPercent), clamped to 0.15 minimum.

findings.what: Cake form: stun duration is 4.5s but original is 6s
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:1716 nextActionDC.reset(cake_recover, 6) — Cake is vulnerable for 6 seconds after all candles extinguished.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2573 after(4.5, ...) in guardBroken — 4.5s regardless of whether it's cake or durian form. Durian also uses 4.5s in the original (:650 recoverNow after 4.5s), so only cake is wrong.
findings.fix: In guardBroken, pass the stun duration as a parameter. For cake, use 6.0s; for durian and sundae, keep 4.5s.

findings.what: Durian action loop differs: original has dur_cornerSpinSlam (teleport to edge, spin across) but ours maps it to dur_slam which behaves differently
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:562-577 dur_cornerSpinSlam: immediately positions Burrito at x=0 or x=850, yVel=-5 upward, xVel=±30, enters SPECIAL mode which drops via gravity (yVel+=acceleration per frame) to DURIAN_GROUNDY=320 and lands — a diagonal arc from corner. Plays dur_spin anim throughout.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2748-2759 dur_slam: teleports to x=0 or 800, y=0, sets xVel=±18, yVel=-5, mode='spin' — nearly the same concept. However ours also sets flying=true then immediately false (line 2750-2751 apparent bug: sets flying=true, then flying=false on the same synchronous block). Also xVel=18 vs original 30.
findings.fix: Fix the flying=true/false double-set bug (remove the first flying=true or the second flying=false). Increase xVel to 30 to match original. Check that GROUND_Y used in 'spin' mode (325) matches DURIAN_GROUNDY (320) — 5px off but acceptable.

findings.what: Cake action loop has 5 entries vs original 6 (missing second cake_shoot4 at index 4)
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:95 allActionsArray[5] = [cake_shoot2x2, cake_shoot4, cake_flyup, cake_shoot2x2, cake_shoot4, cake_sing] — 6 entries; shoot4 appears twice.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2443 cake actions=['ck_shoot2x2','ck_shoot4','ck_flyup','ck_shoot2x2','ck_sing'] — 5 entries; missing second ck_shoot4 before ck_sing.
findings.fix: Insert 'ck_shoot4' between 'ck_shoot2x2' and 'ck_sing' to match original 6-action sequence.

findings.what: Cake shoot timings are fixed; original scales next-action delay by healthRemainingPercent (attacks get more frequent as HP drops)
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:1550 chooseNewActionSoon(2.5 + 1.5*healthRemainingPercent), :1558 chooseNewActionSoon(3 + 1.5*healthRemainingPercent), :1567 chooseNewActionSoon(11.5 + 1.5*healthRemainingPercent). At full HP waits 4s/4.5s/13s; at 1HP waits 2.5s/3s/11.5s.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2839 actionTimer=3 (fixed) for both shoot2x2 and shoot4; sing actionTimer=7 (fixed). Ours is faster than original at full HP, slightly slower at low HP.
findings.fix: Compute hpFraction = (this.hp - form.minHp) / (form_entry_hp - form.minHp) and use actionTimer = 2.5 + 1.5*hpFraction for shoot2x2, 3 + 1.5*hpFraction for shoot4, 7 + 1.5*hpFraction for sing.

findings.what: Phase-change first-action delay: original always waits 1.5s after change anim; ours adds 1.2s on top of 1.6s transition
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:3057-3065 newActionAfterChange plays immediately after change anim finishes, then chooseNewActionSoon(1.5).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:2499-2509 after(1.6, ...) fires busyChange=false + optional minion spawns, then sets actionTimer=1.2. Total delay from change anim start is ~(change_anim_duration) + 1.6 + 1.2 = 2.8s extra after anim vs original 1.5s. Burst forms (durian/cake) wait even longer.
findings.fix: Remove the additional actionTimer=1.2 delay after the 1.6s transition timer, or reduce 1.6 to match. Change anim callback sets actionTimer=1.5 directly.

findings.what: onDeath plays combo_die sound even in non-combo forms (e.g. if Burrito dies mid-watermelon form)
findings.original: Boss_Burrito.as:3118 onDestroyed plays die anim. No combo_die sound — that's the actual Combo boss's death sound.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3010-3014 onDeath plays audio.play('combo_die'). Burrito should play a burrito-specific death sound or none, not combo_die.
findings.fix: Change onDeath to play a form-appropriate sound or remove the hardcoded 'combo_die' call. Check assets for a 'burrito_die' or 'boss_kill_sound' equivalent.

findings.what: Action loop is missing 3 of 8 original actions (sideFlyToMiddle, flyThenStaffSmash/teleportSmashForward, fartAndLaugh)
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:24 — actionsArray has 8 entries in order: ["shoot2", "sideFlyToMiddle", "flyThenStaffSmash", "smashDown", "fartAndLaugh", "sideBlasts", "highfiveshots", "eagleSwoop"]. sideFlyToMiddle = both MMs fly to ground and rush each other with laser lines, smashing if bunny is in the way (preSmashMiddle:787, SMASHING state, lazer effect). flyThenStaffSmash = MM teleports to side opposite bunny off-screen then teleportSmashForward (appear beside player, staffSmashForward anim:1231). fartAndLaugh = MM faces away, emits fart cloud that tracks player for 5 seconds (checkFartCollision repeats 50x at 0.1s, BUNNY_PASS_OUT stun then teleportSmashForward:1177-1195).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3025 — actions array has only 6 entries: ['shoot2', 'smashDown', 'eagleSwoop', 'sideBlasts', 'staffSmash', 'rapidshot']. sideFlyToMiddle and fartAndLaugh are completely absent. staffSmash (line 3195) partially replaces flyThenStaffSmash but is a simplified teleport-forward with a simple box check, missing the off-screen fly-in positioning, the laser line during the rush, and the BUNNY_PASS_OUT path.
findings.fix: Document the three missing actions in a // SOLO-CONDENSED comment. For single-player the sideFlyToMiddle could be replaced by a solo laser-rush (single MM charges across the screen with spark trail). fartAndLaugh can port directly (no partner needed). This is the biggest fidelity gap.

findings.what: rapidshot cancel condition is inverted — original cancels the barrage when the player HIT the boss; ours also cancels but triggers stopRapid on any hit regardless of HP phase
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:940-948 — onHurt() checks `if(action == RAPIDSHOT)` then calls flyUpAndOffAfterRapid(). This is ONLY reachable during the highfiveshots action (which is itself gated to `hpRemaining <= maxHP/2`). So the barrage only starts below 50% HP (line 269: `if( (this.hpRemaining > this.maxHP / 2) || (partnerDead) )` skips to next action), and hitting the boss mid-barrage cancels it by flying off-screen (FLYING2 state), after which both MMs enter recoverFromGround (line 1087).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3115 — `if (action === 'rapidshot' && this.hp > this.type.hp / 2) action = 'shoot2'` gates the action correctly. onHurt:3239 calls stopRapid() which plays flyUpOff and glides away. The cancel mechanic is structurally correct BUT stopRapid does NOT trigger a 'recoverFromGround' or equivalent — the boss immediately returns to normal idle and picks the next action after a 0.8s glide + 1s timer (line 3235), losing the original stumble/stun recovery feel (original: recoverFromGround → standUp anim → chooseNewAction ~4s total).
findings.fix: After stopRapid, play 'standUp' anim then delay the next action by ~2-3s to match the original stumble recovery window.

findings.what: Eagle swoop: ours uses random Y heights; original uses two fixed alternating heights per pass for each MM
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:304-317 — startEagleSwoop uses shoot3Index (0 or 1) to set fixed Y: case 0 mainMM y=300, case 1 mainMM y=350. Two passes only (shoot3Index > 2 ends). Heights are deterministic and staggered so the two MMs swoop at different altitudes creating a weave pattern.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3090-3093 — on each new pass: `this.y = 200 + Math.random() * 150` (range 200-350). Passes are 3 total (swoopCount >= 3 ends) vs original's 2 passes per-MM (shoot3Index > 2 means 3 passes for a single MM). The random heights remove the telegraphed weave pattern and add an extra pass.
findings.fix: Use fixed heights: pass 0 → y=300, pass 1 → y=350 (matching original mainMM values). Cap at 2 passes (swoopCount >= 2). Start from off-screen x=-100 or x=900 each pass (already correct) but only two passes.

findings.what: staffSmash uses simple box overlap; original uses two ray-cast line segments and has a completely different hit outcome (bunny KO throw)
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:635-722 — teleportSmashForward: staffSmashForward anim, collision check at +0.45s via checkStaffCollision which fires two ray-box intersects. On hit → bunnyKOSmash: bunny is tweened to partner, then thrown across the screen (tween chain over 0.65s), then partner staffSmashDown, then doubleLaugh + chooseNewActionSoon(2). This is a multi-step cinematic sequence. On miss → chooseNewActionSoon(1).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3195-3210 — staffSmash: teleports beside player, plays staffSmashForward. At +0.45s checks `Math.abs(player.x - this.x) < 130 && Math.abs(player.y - 40 - (this.y - 30)) < 80`, calls hurtPlayer with attackDmg, shake(4). actionTimer = 1.6. No KO throw sequence, no laugh, no cinematic. The teleportOut anim is also unverified in the original (original uses alpha fade + scaleX tween, not a named teleport anim).
findings.fix: The KO throw is the original's marquee moment for this action. Even in solo: on hit, trigger a knockback/stun state on the player (existing injureBunny logic), play staffSmashDown anim, then laugh anim before resuming. Add a miss path that just plays idle and continues. Replace teleportOut with alpha=0 + scaleX=0.1 tween matching original lines 1211-1230.

findings.what: shoot2 action timer is correct (3.5s) but ours starts the timer AFTER the 1s glide completes; original starts it immediately from preShoot2 which is called after the 1s fly-to completes — they match. However each individual shot fires 'shootEnergy01' → 0.5s delay → projectile; original does this for BOTH shots but ours replays the entire shootEnergy01 anim at +1.5s with an inner 0.5s delay, making the second shot at +2.0s. Original second shot is also at 1.5+0.5 = 2.0s. This matches. Low risk.
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:850-866 — preShoot2 on mainMM: delayCall(shoot1, 0.5) and delayCall(shoot1, 1.5); each shoot1 plays shootEnergy01, then addProjectile at +0.5s. So shots land at t=1.0s and t=2.0s from preShoot2. chooseNewActionSoon(3.5) gives 3.5s total before next action.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3124-3131 — after glide: plays shootEnergy01, after(0.5) fires energyBall (t=0.5s), after(1.5) plays shootEnergy01 again, inner after(0.5) fires (t=2.0s). actionTimer=3.5. Shot timing matches but the second shootEnergy01 replaying is redundant animation-wise since the first would have completed.
findings.fix: No functional change needed; minor cleanup: call `this.spriter.playAnim('shootEnergy01', 'idle', null, true)` at t=1.5 (already correct) — just note the shots land at t=0.5 and t=2.0 as intended.

findings.what: sideBlasts: ours fires 3 horizontal projectiles in a spread; original fires a single SUPER_BLAST event (a screen-wide shockwave) with NO projectiles
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:494-518 — sideBlastNow dispatches 'SUPER_BLAST' event (handled by LevelBase as a full-screen or very-wide hit), NOT individual projectiles. 3 rounds of blasts, each at a different height pair (prepareNextSideBlast:520-562 has 3 cases with y values 100/350, 250/150, 350/280). Total 3 blasts per side with repositioning between each.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3175-3178 — fires 3 individual energy-ball projectiles at dy offsets of -20, 0, +20 with xVel=12. This is weaker and less dramatic than a screen-wide blast. The repositioning between blasts is done by `startGlide(this.x, 100+Math.random()*230, 0.6, blast)` (only Y changes, X stays put) which doesn't match the original's distinct position pairs.
findings.fix: Replace the 3-projectile spray with a services.superBlast() (wide line hit) or a very large hitbox projectile covering most of the screen width. For positioning, use the original's 3 fixed Y pairs (round 0: y≈100 and 350, round 1: y≈250 and 150, round 2: y≈350 and 280) — in solo, just use the MM's own Y from each case.

findings.what: smashDown: ours positions boss 160px ABOVE player and drops; original positions beside player at y-30 then teleports both MMs into a simultaneous double-staff smash with a 0.3s delay before canDamage
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:235-246 — both MMs fly to (bunny.x±150, bunny.y-30), then doubleSmash:619-627 — both play staffSmashDown, setBothCanDamage at +0.3s, chooseNewActionSoon(1.5).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3135-3150 — glides to (player.x±150, player.y-160) — 130px higher than original. After 0.5s plays staffSmashDown, +0.3s canDamage=true, yVel=8 (physically drops), +0.9s cancels. The drop mechanic (yVel=8, flying=false) is invented — original does NOT have a drop; the bosses just play the staffSmashDown anim in place at ground level (y-30 from bunny). The invented drop could miss if the player moves.
findings.fix: Position at player.y - 30 (not -160). Remove the yVel=8 drop — original just sets canDamage at +0.3s while playing the anim in place. The anim itself visually extends downward.

findings.what: Eagle swoop: ours starts the swoop from the side OPPOSITE the player; original starts from the SAME side the boss is already on (if x<400 start from left, else from right)
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:322-336 — startEagleSwoop: `if(this.x < 400) { movingRight=true; this.x=-100; }` — the boss teleports to SAME side it started on (left if x<400, right if x>400).
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3153-3160 — `startGlide(player.x < 400 ? 900 : -100, 250, 0.6, ...)` — glides to the side OPPOSITE the player. Then `faceOverride = this.x > 400 ? -1 : 1` so it faces center. This is opposite of original: original starts from the boss's current side, ours starts from the player's opposite side.
findings.fix: Remove the pre-swoop glide. In the callback, set `this.x = this.x < 400 ? -100 : 900` directly (instant reposition like original), set faceOverride toward screen center, then begin swooping.

findings.what: rapidshot barrage: ours fires exactly 16 shots with no time limit; original fires indefinitely at 0.3s intervals until the boss is hit (no shot cap, no hard timeout except natural game flow)
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:399-418 — onRapidShot1 and onRapidShot2 both call themselves recursively with delayCall(0.3) as long as `action == RAPIDSHOT`. No shot counter, no ceiling. Ends only when onHurt() sets action != RAPIDSHOT via flyUpAndOffAfterRapid.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3219-3223 — `if (++shots < 16) this.after(0.3, fire); else this.stopRapid()` — hard cap of 16 shots then auto-stops. This makes the barrage feel time-limited rather than player-skill-dependent. With 16 shots at 0.3s intervals that is a 4.8s automatic window.
findings.fix: Remove the shot counter cap. Let the barrage fire indefinitely (or with a very long timeout ~10s) and rely solely on the player hitting the boss to cancel it via onHurt. This preserves the skill-test intent.

findings.what: rapidshot position: ours glides to fixed x=400 (center); original positions both MMs symmetrically — each on their respective side oscillating between two x positions via rapidTweens()
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:371-397 — rapidTweens: if this.x < 400, oscillate between x1=140 and x2=340 over 2s each; else between x1=660 and x2=460. Both MMs oscillate on their own side. In solo the partner is absent, so only one MM's tween matters.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3215 + 3100 — glides to x=400, then during rapidFiring `this.xVel = Math.sin(performance.now()/600)*3` (±3px/frame sine wave, very small). Original oscillates ±100px over 2s; ours moves ±3px. The boss barely moves during the barrage instead of sweeping 100px back and forth.
findings.fix: Replace the sine oscillation with a proper tween alternating between x=140↔x=340 (or 460↔660 depending on side) over 2s intervals, matching original's rapidTweens behavior.

findings.what: Action loop has a different order and count (6 vs 8 actions); loop sequence doesn't match original
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:24 — 8 actions in order: shoot2, sideFlyToMiddle, flyThenStaffSmash, smashDown, fartAndLaugh, sideBlasts, highfiveshots, eagleSwoop.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3025 — 6 actions: shoot2, smashDown, eagleSwoop, sideBlasts, staffSmash, rapidshot. Even ignoring the missing duo-only actions, smashDown occurs at index 1 (original index 3), eagleSwoop at index 2 (original index 7). The pacing rhythm — two projectile actions before anything physical — is lost.
findings.fix: Reorder to approximate original rhythm: shoot2, [solo-laser-rush replacing sideFlyToMiddle], staffSmash [replacing flyThenStaffSmash], smashDown, [fartAndLaugh if added], sideBlasts, rapidshot [replacing highfiveshots], eagleSwoop.

findings.what: spawn initial delay is 4.5s in ours vs 6s in original
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:157 — `chooseNewActionSoon(6)` after spawn anim completes.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3040 — `this.actionTimer = 4.5` set in spawnAt. The spawn anim plays separately (hasAnim('spawn')), so effective delay is approximately anim duration + 4.5s. Original adds 6s delay AFTER the spawn anim callback (bossSpawnComplete at line 155 which calls chooseNewActionSoon(6)).
findings.fix: In the spawn anim callback, set actionTimer = 6 instead of 4.5 to match original post-spawn pause.

findings.what: glide movement is eased (ease-out quadratic); original uses linear tweens for flyTo
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:757-765 — flyTo uses `new Tween(this, time)` with default linear transition. Arrivals are crisp, not eased.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3069 — `const ease = 1 - (1 - u) ** 2` (quadratic ease-out). Boss decelerates into position. This gives a floatier feel than the snappy linear movement in the original.
findings.fix: Change ease formula to `u` (linear) or use a very mild ease to preserve crispness.

findings.what: highfiveshots / rapidshot: original plays 'highfive' + 'highFiveIdle' + 'aimDownAfterHigh' + 'shootDownIdle' anim chain; ours skips straight to 'aimDownAfterHigh'
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:345-368 — highFive at +0.25s: both MMs face each other, play 'highfive' → 'highFiveIdle'; highFiveFinished at +1.2s: play 'aimDownAfterHigh' → 'shootDownIdle'. The highfive animation is the visual tell that rapid-fire is about to start.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3215-3216 — glides to x=400, immediately plays 'aimDownAfterHigh' → 'shootDownIdle'. The highfive setup animation is skipped entirely.
findings.fix: Play 'highfive' → 'highFiveIdle' for ~1.2s before transitioning to 'aimDownAfterHigh'. This is the player's visual cue to start hitting the boss.

findings.what: Invented behavior: glide returns early (line 3077), blocking idle deceleration and faceplayer during glide; original runs all per-frame logic always
findings.original: Boss_MagicMan.as:951-1130 — update() always runs all state checks sequentially. There is no early return during a tween since tweens are handled by the Juggler (external), not the update loop.
findings.ours: BossBehaviors.ts:3065-3077 — during a glide the function returns early at line 3077, skipping `faceOverride` update and deceleration. This means the boss does not face the player while gliding. Also the xVel/yVel are zeroed at glide start (line 3044) — original pre_fly anim plays first then a 0.2s tween delay, no velocity zeroing.
findings.fix: Do not early-return during glide; let faceOverride update even while gliding so the boss tracks the player visually during approach.
